title: Band personnel at the start in St. Louis
summary: Asked for the personnel, they list the reed section, Edison, Snub Mosley, Serp Goodson, Godley, Louis Pitts and guitarist Jimmy Miller.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: : Who -- was in the band at that time, what was the personnel?

The personnel of the band, at that time, was our reed section, Charles Pillars, Hayes Pillars and James Jeter. In the brass section, he -- we had Harry Sweets Edison, and Leo Snub Mosley on the trombone. On the piano, we had Serp Goodson. On the bass -- on the drums we had A. G. Godley, and on the bass we had Nunu -- on the bass. His name was Louie Pitts --
And Louie Pitts on the bass.
Wait a minute, what about Jimmy, guitar player.
OH, yes we did, we had a guitar, Jimmy Miller on the guitar, yes we did.
From Akron, Ohio, Jimmy Miller. He so -- he was a fine guitarist --
